name: socai-social-research
description: Research public posts, comments, creators, and trends on Xiaohongshu, X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Douyin with the local socai CLI and the user's authenticated Chrome session.

interface.longDescription: Research public posts, comments, creators, and trends on Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote), Douyin, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and X through the locally installed Socai CLI and the user's authenticated Chrome session. Designed for local shell-enabled agent workflows. Socai social-platform research is read-only and returns source-linked evidence.
capabilities: Analyze Douyin and TikTok videos, authors, and audience responses
Research Instagram, LinkedIn, and X profiles and posts
Return source-linked evidence for social listening and competitor research
Use the local Socai CLI and the user's authenticated Chrome session
defaultPrompt: Research Xiaohongshu comments about Adidas running shoes and cite every source.
Compare TikTok and Instagram reactions to this product with source links.
Find recurring customer complaints across the relevant social platforms.
